title: Slow English Podcast #67: Bosnia and Herzegovina

sentences.text: In this episode, we will talk about a very interesting and beautiful country.
This country is called Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Many people call it Bosnia for short.
Bosnia and Herzegovina is in Europe, and it has a lot to offer.
It has beautiful nature, a rich culture, long history, and very kind people.
I will speak slowly and clearly, listen carefully and try to understand.
Let's begin.
Where is Bosnia and Herzegovina?
Bosnia and Herzegovina is a country in southeast Europe.
It is part of a region called the Balkans.
It shares borders with Croatia to the north and west, Serbia to the east,
and Montenegro to the south.
Bosnia and Herzegovina is almost landlocked, but it has a small coastline on the Adriatic Sea.
The coastline is only about 20 kilometers long, but it is very beautiful.
The capital city of Bosnia and Herzegovina is Sarajevo.
Sarajevo is a very old and special city.
It is surrounded by mountains and has a river running through it.
People of different cultures and religions live in Sarajevo.
You can see mosques, churches, and synagogues close to each other in the same neighborhood.
It is a symbol of peace and togetherness.
What is Bosnia and Herzegovina famous for?
Bosnia and Herzegovina is famous for its nature, history, and culture.
It is a country with green forests, high mountains, clear rivers, and historic towns.
One famous place in Bosnia is the city of Maastar.
Maastar is known for its beautiful old bridge called the Starimost, which means old bridge.
The bridge was built in the 1500s.
It was destroyed during the war in the 1990s, but later rebuilt.
Today, many people visit Maastar to see the bridge and the river.
In summer, some brave people even jumped from the bridge into the river.
Bosnia is also famous for its winter sports.
In 1984, the Winter Olympics were held in Sarajevo.
You can still visit the Olympic Mountains today.
People go skiing, snowboarding, and hiking in the mountains around Sarajevo.
What is the food like in Bosnia and Herzegovina?
The food in Bosnia and Herzegovina is very tasty and filling.
It is a mix of Eastern European and Ottoman cuisine.
People eat a lot of meat, bread, vegetables, and soups.
One of the most famous dishes is Chevapi.
Chevapi are small grilled meat sausages.
They are served with soft bread called somen, chopped onions,
and sometimes a red pepper sauce called ivar.
Another popular food is burek.
Burek is a baked pastry filled with meat.
There are also other versions with cheese, spinach, or potatoes.
People usually eat burek for breakfast or lunch.
You can buy it in small shops called burek genica.
For dessert, people love to eat baklava, which is made within pastry, nuts, and sweet syrup.
It is very sweet and delicious.
Another sweet is tufa hija, which is a poached apple filled with nuts and sugar.
People also drink a lot of coffee, especially strong Turkish-style coffee.
Culture and people.
The people of Bosnia and Herzegovina are known for being friendly, warm, and hospitable.
They love to welcome visitors and share their culture.
Family is very important.
People enjoy spending time with their relatives, especially during holidays and weekends.
Bosnian Herzegovina is home to three main ethnic groups, Bosniaks, Croats, and Serbs.
The official languages are Bosnian, Croatian, and Serbian, which are very similar.
In big cities, many young people also speak English.
There are many festivals and holidays in Bosnia.
People celebrate with music, dancing, and traditional clothes.
One famous event is the Sarajevo Film Festival, which shows movies from around the world.
Another important holiday is Eid, which many Muslim people celebrate with prayers and special food.
Traditional music in Bosnia is also special.
One popular style is called Septilinka.
It is emotional and beautiful, and it talks about love and life.
People sing it with traditional instruments, nature, and animals.
Bosnia and Herzegovina has amazing natural beauty.
There are many rivers, lakes, forests, and mountains.
In summer, people enjoy swimming, rafting, fishing, and camping.
In winter, people go skiing in the snowy mountains.
The country is also home to many animals.
In the forests, you can see bears, wolves, foxes, and wild boars.
There are many types of birds and fish too.
Bosnia is a great place for people who love nature and outdoor adventures.
One special place is the Una National Park, which has beautiful waterfalls and clean rivers.
Another beautiful place is the Kravita Waterfalls.
Many people go there to relax and enjoy the view.
Conclusion, Bosnia and Herzegovina is a beautiful and peaceful country
with so much to see and enjoy.
It has amazing nature, rich history, delicious food, and friendly people.
Whether you want to visit old towns, enjoy the mountains, eat tasty food,
or learn about different cultures,
Bosnia is a great place to visit.
Would you like to visit Bosnia and Herzegovina one day?
I hope you enjoyed learning about this wonderful country today.
I hope you learned something new.
